reviews.t: Hi WRD team, the vocabulary listening feature is very helpful. However, when I stop listening halfway and reopen the app, it always starts from the beginning. If a list has many words, I have to scroll to find where I left off, which wastes time. It would be great if the app could remember the last position and let users continue from there. Thank you!

The app contains several really useful features, like audio mode, grouping the words into categories by popularity/proficiency, but IMHO it is not really helpful for me. I am learning Polish and app just does not have enough Polish words to actually make a difference in learning the language. I was waiting for several months to see some more words but didn't see a substantial difference - too many really useful words are still missing. Going to cancel the subscription unfortunately...

The app was good and I was starting to consider taking a membership, until this bug. I'm supposed to write the word I hear, but the letters do not appear and I can't type it myself. I restarted the app. I restarted my phone. I reinstalled the app. The bug is still there when I resume the lesson. Therefore I litterally can't continue learning
